name: save-load-portfeat
purpose: iter-465 save lane: LOAD GAME from the custom MAIN MENU with a save made by an earlier roll (requires.contentSeed: -Gates SR_CONTENT_DIR=<that roll's content root>), PORT FEATURES ON. MAIN MENU -> DOWN, A = LOAD GAME -> the game's slot picker (FillSlotInfo; LOAD mode focuses the first in-use slot) -> A -> LoadTask -> LoadComplete(true) -> the host slot tracker holds the slot -> the loaded game (first hour: straight into main_hud; past it: the METROPOLIS / FORTRESS menu). SR_DEVTOOLS=objstate (read-only) reports the restored chapter and objective bits. -Gates SR_PORT_FEATURES=1,SR_CONTENT_DIR=<seed>,SR_DEVTOOLS=objstate. -TimeoutSeconds 480.

steps.name: slots-filled
steps.purpose: the slot picker's in-use slot is filled: its save image is requested (FillSlotInfo; the old [PATH_RESOLVE] marker cannot fire since iter-464's skip_lr). Counted only after LOAD GAME was entered

steps.name: load-lands
steps.purpose: the loaded game's first screen: main_hud (first hour) or ScrMainMenu (past it); not expectFresh - LoadComplete requests it inside the same call (natural_load.json)
